WITH r AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.etl_loaded_at, d.fiscal_year
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39
)
SELECT fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl,
       MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM r GROUP BY 1

SELECT store_key, store_id, store_name, region, format, open_date, close_date, valid_from, valid_to, is_current
FROM dim_store WHERE store_id IN (101,102,103,104,105,114,119,125,129,136,137) OR store_id >= 900 ORDER BY store_id, valid_from

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.net_amount AS before_ret
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net, 0
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.before_ret) AS before_ret
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.store_id, SUM(c.net_sales) AS c_net, SUM(c.net_sales_before_returns) AS c_before
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = c.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39 AND c.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) sid, m.net_sales, c.c_net, ROUND(m.net_sales-c.c_net,2) diff_net, ROUND(m.before_ret-c.c_before,2) diff_before
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.fiscal_year=m.fiscal_year AND c.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE m.net_sales IS NULL OR c.c_net IS NULL OR ABS(m.net_sales-c.c_net) > 0.5 OR ABS(m.before_ret-c.c_before)>0.5
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
                FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, c.store_id, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ns
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = c.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39 GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT sw.store_id, sw.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sw.trading) AS trading_weeks,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.ns > 0) AS weeks_with_sales,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sw.trading AND COALESCE(s.ns,0) <= 0) AS trading_no_sales,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT sw.trading AND s.ns > 0) AS nontrading_with_sales
FROM store_weeks sw LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.store_id=sw.store_id AND s.fiscal_year=sw.fiscal_year AND s.fiscal_week=sw.fiscal_week
GROUP BY 1,2
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sw.trading) <> 13 OR COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.ns > 0) <> COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sw.trading)
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
                FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_week = 27
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    CROSS JOIN range_start rs
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= rs.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_region AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, ty.region,
       ty.net_sales AS this_year_net_sales, ly.net_sales AS last_year_net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct, ty.stores
FROM by_region ty JOIN by_region ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.region
